text:
maria: Hey team — planning a Micro Recognition lunch & learn next Wed 12:30pm PT. Quick 45m session: 10m overview of peer recognition process, 20m demo of new nomination form, 15m Q&A. Looking for volunteers to host and a headcount for catering. Sign-up sheet: https://forms.gle/abc123 (please select if you need vegetarian/gluten-free).

oliver: count me in to co-host — I can do the demo. @maria will you need slides or just a live walkthrough?

maria: Slides would be great for the intro + 2 example nominations. I'll create a shared deck and add a rough outline.

nina: I can promote this in comms and post a calendar invite once you share the deck blurb. what should the blurb say?

maria: Short blurb: "Join us for a quick lunch & learn on peer recognition — how it works, how to nominate, and Q&A. All are welcome; limited in-person seats. Lunch provided."

adele: RSVPing — People Ops will send 12 folks. Dietary: 2 vegan, 1 gluten-free. I'll fill that in on the form.

jen: Support team: 3 people, 1 vegetarian. Thanks for organizing!

sam: Is this open to everyone or managers only? Curious if we should push to new hires.

maria: Open to everyone — especially new hires and ICs. Planning to cap at 40 for the room; if we hit capacity we'll stream.

recog-bot: FYI — nomination form updated with "impact" field and optional anonymized story. See release notes: /docs/recognition-form-changelog

oliver: Demo outline (to be put in the deck):
```
- 2 slides: why recognition matters
- live: how to nominate (form walkthrough)
- examples: 3 accepted nominations + lessons
- QA and next steps
```

maria: Also need a volunteer to pick up boxed lunches on the day. @sam could you help with pickup (BlueBox Cafe, 12pm)? We'll reimburse up to $250.

sam: I can pick up at 12pm. Will submit expense with receipts.

adele: I can submit the expense request once you drop receipts in Concur.

maria: :thumbsup: thanks. Final logistics: please update the sign-up form by Friday EOD with your headcount and dietary needs. I'll send the calendar invite Monday with the deck link and the room booking.

nina: Promotional blurb is ready — I'll post in #general and pin the sign-up link Monday morning. :party-parrot: 

jen: I'll add a small FAQ section to the doc about spot award eligibility and taxability so we can answer questions live.

maria: Perfect. If anyone wants to co-present a real nomination story, reply here. Thanks all — will follow up with the calendar invite and final headcount.
